_comment: Tangerine II: named instruments, paths relative to the sample folder (samples/ or ../SAMPLES). folder = one note per file; files = a few files (pitch from the name, else measured); roots = the MIDI note of each file, measured once (60 = C4, decimals for a detuned synth), which wins over the name; sfz = a mapped SFZ. Only single notes: a sample that holds a chord turns sour when the harmony moves. Change a file name here to change a sound.
